g.text: Residual unit: Conv3d → GroupNorm → LeakyReLU → Conv3d → GroupNorm;
add identity / 1×1×1 shortcut → LeakyReLU. Downsampling: 2×2×2 MaxPool3d.
Shared patient splits and 64 × 128 × 128 resampled RAS grid. Feature-map sizes omit batch; 3D sizes are D × H × W.
Each head loss: TRAIN-weighted categorical CE + soft multiclass Dice. Auxiliary targets use nearest-neighbour resizing; inference uses main argmax only.
